explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 30 is mostly timing: high at D1 (~+0.8), mid at GO (~+0.5), strongly negative at D2 (~-0.7); timing alone gives R^2 0.89. Beyond timing, observed-only: (1) GO is the main modulated phase, set by the previous trial: strongly lower after a1 S2 unrewarded (-0.67 residual), lower after a1 S1 u and a2 S2 u, higher after rewarded a2 trials or a2 S1 (roughly the inverse of an a1 win-stay/lose-switch signal: high when the agent leans away from a1 / toward a2); an additional drop when the trial before last was also unrewarded (losing streaks push GO negative). (2) D2 depends on the choice x reached state just observed: much less negative after rare a2->S1 (+0.45 residual, stronger when belief favors S2), slightly up for a1->S1, down when S2 is reached; small extra D2 shifts from the last trial pattern. (3) D1 is slightly higher after an a2 choice than an a1 choice. (4) At D1/GO a small graded term in ideal-observer belief log-odds (higher when S2 is believed good). Future, hidden and model-output terms are not used. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.688 (8-term variant with phase-split belief gave test 0.680); profile ceilings: all observed 0.76, all 0.81; the observed-only reference for last trial (0.39) roughly matches the model-policy decile (0.41), so dropping the model value/policy loses little.

issues: Reproduced test R^2 beyond timing 0.680. The fitted signs match each claim: GO last-trial table weight +0.90; GO trial-before-unrewarded weight -0.15 ('losing streaks push GO negative'); D1 prev_action a2>a1 weight +0.088; belief_lo at D1/GO weight -0.014, so the value is higher when S2 is believed good; D2 a2->S1 x belief_lo weight -0.034. The profile tables agree: GO after a1 S2 u -0.665; D2 choice x state cells 4:+0.07, 5:-0.23, 7:+0.45, 8:-0.15; D1 a2 about +0.12 vs a1 about -0.12.

Misses show no large systematic class. Mean error by phase is within ±0.04, and the worst (phase, previous trial) cells are under 0.1 (GO after rewarded trials +0.09; D1 after unrewarded a1 -0.076, a small prev_reward effect at D1 that the label leaves out).

The worst-fit windows are long runs of unrewarded trials (repeated a2->S1 rare unrewarded, or a1 S1 unrewarded). There GO stays near -0.3 against a prediction of +0.5, and D2 on a2->S1 builds up across repeats. Targeted fixes add little on test: GO 3-trial loss streak 0.687; GO |belief_lo| 0.691; a2->S1 run count at D2 0.687; clipped -belief_lo at D2 0.689. So this run effect is real but only partly captured, and it is small in variance terms.

Minor overclaim: '84% of all' sets 0.68 against the 'all' ceiling of 0.81, which includes future and model-output cues. Against the observed-only ceiling (0.76) it is about 90%. The 'costs little' argument compares two reference tables (0.39 vs 0.41), not the earlier model-based explanation's score.
The D2 last-trial term (term 7) and the D1 term are small effects; the label correctly describes them as small.
